parameters.query: SELECT event_id,severity,rule_id,src_ip,username,triage_decision,confidence_score,processed_at FROM bt_alert_log WHERE triage_decision='MANUAL_REVIEW' AND processed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '12 hours' ORDER BY processed_at DESC;
SELECT incident_id,type,severity,team,due_at,jira_key,created_at FROM incidents WHERE status='Open' ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'Critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'High' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END;
SELECT correlation_id,type,pivot,severity,alert_count,mitre_hypothesis FROM correlated_incidents WHERE resolution IS NULL AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '12 hours';

meta.description: End-of-shift: queries open tickets, alerts, incidents, active correlations. Generates formatted handover posted to Slack.
